objective: Repair detection recall in criteria_addressed so the prohibition and form branches are reached on the phrasings the planner actually emits, and demonstrate it by replaying the committed -027 criteria.
evidence: .orchestration/responses/ARCH-20260922-029.response.json — _PROHIBITION_MARKER vocabulary verbatim; 'contains no instances of' unmatched; _STRUCTURAL_VERB matched 'contains' but _FIELD_VOCAB & _terms was empty so form was not entered either
.orchestration/responses/ARCH-20260922-031.response.json — the corpus measurement and the unmatched-phrase list (this command's input)
docs/traces/b17-prohibition-branch.jsonl — criterion 1 and the 401-word compliant draft

tests/test_prohibition_phrasing.py — TestTheLiveWordingIsMisclassified pins the known defect and is EXPECTED to fail when this command lands; TestTheInversionItselfIsCorrect must keep passing unchanged
AGENTS.md convention 17 — when a fix invalidates a test, ask which of the two is wrong first
AGENTS.md convention 22 — an instrument's test simulates the condition it watches, end to end
constraints: Ruling B17-R2′(a) is the specification: recall derived from and validated against the corpus, never from one exhibit.

THIS IS RECALL ONLY. Do NOT introduce an abstention on any path that does not already abstain. Do NOT touch the fallthrough. An abstention may not ship before ARCH-20260922-033 gives the fold an empty seat — that ordering is ruled.
Recall may only ADD recognized surface forms. Every criterion classified prohibition or form BEFORE this change must still be classified the same way after it. Assert this as a test.

Broaden by deriving patterns from the corpus's verbatim phrases, and cite which corpus phrase justifies each added pattern. A pattern with no corpus exhibit behind it is not licensed (convention 21, applied to patterns).

Do not broaden so far that a genuine presence criterion is captured. Presence-shaped criteria must be unaffected; assert on the presence exhibits and confirm the 71-100% / 0-33% separation from the record still holds.
Do not change the 50% threshold. The threshold is not the question; recognition is.

TestTheLiveWordingIsMisclassified is EXPECTED to fail after this change. Do not delete or weaken it — update it deliberately and say so, per convention 17 and per its own docstring, which instructs exactly that.

THE REPLAY IS THE ACCEPTANCE: replaying the committed -027 criteria through the repaired classifier must classify criterion 1 as prohibition, extract all four forbidden tokens, and PASS the committed 401-word compliant draft. Criterion 3 must classify form. If either does not, say so — that is the result, not a reason to widen further.
The replay must read the criteria from the committed trace by content, not from a restated string (convention 24).
Keep the diff small and confined to checks.py and tests/.
acceptance_criteria: Criterion 1 of the committed -027 trace classifies prohibition, with all four forbidden tokens extracted, quoted in the response.
The committed compliant 401-word draft PASSES criterion 1 under the repaired classifier.
Criterion 3 classifies form (or abstains once -034 lands; until then it may classify as it does now — state which).
No criterion classified prohibition or form before the change classifies differently after it, demonstrated by a regression test over the corpus.
Each added pattern cites the corpus phrase that justifies it.
TestTheLiveWordingIsMisclassified was updated deliberately, not deleted, and the update is stated.
No new abstention path was introduced — assert this in the response.
Suite count reported before and after.

verification.expected: All pass; count reported before and after.

verification.command: .venv/bin/python3 -m pytest tests/ -q -k 'prohibition or coverage_shapes or recall'
verification.expected: The replay test and the regression test pass.

rollback: Revert the commit; the marker vocabulary returns to the exhibit-derived set and the -027 criterion is misclassified again.
assumptions: The prohibition branch, once reached, is correct — it is demonstrated by fixtures in tests/test_prohibition_phrasing.py::TestTheInversionItselfIsCorrect. This command repairs REACHING it, not its logic.
The corpus from -031 covers enough distinct phrasings to derive patterns from.
questions: If the corpus shows the planner's prohibition phrasings are open-ended — many distinct verbs, few repeats — then a pattern list cannot keep up and the detector needs a different mechanism. If that is what you find, STOP and report rather than adding patterns; that is a shape decision and mine.
B17 closes here if the replay passes. Do you agree that fixture coverage of the fail direction is sufficient for closure, or should the ledger require a live draft containing a banned token?
